{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel value in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0

# Check how many of these are male vs female
sentinel_by_sex = df.loc[sentinel_mask, 'sex'].value_counts()

# Check how many are in treatment vs control arm
sentinel_by_arm = df.loc[sentinel_mask, 'arm'].value_counts()

# Check the response rate among those with sentinel values
sentinel_response_rate = df.loc[sentinel_mask, 'responded'].mean()

# Check the response rate among those without sentinel values
df_clean = df[~sentinel_mask]
non_sentinel_response_rate = df_clean['responded'].mean()

sentinel_by_sex, sentinel_by_arm, sentinel_response_rate, non_sentinel_response_rate"}
